verdict.rationale: Nitrokey 3 firmware source is public on GitHub, described as "fully open source" and dual-licensed under Apache 2.0 and MIT. A probe confirmed the repository has tagged, installable releases (v1.8.3). One community report says the older Nitrokey HSM's on-device applet is not free/open source, so openness does not cover the whole product line. Missing for 10: open-source coverage of every product line (the HSM applet is closed), explicit license evidence for nitropy and other host software, and independent corroboration that the shipped firmware matches the published source.
